new_box =: 3 : 0
    number =. #BoxPool
    box =. y,(<0$a:),<0$a:
    BoxPool =: BoxPool,<box
    number
)

box_height =: 3 : '1{::y{::BoxPool'
box_baseline =: 3 : '2{::y{::BoxPool'
box_descent =: 3 : '(box_height y)-(1+box_baseline y)'

large_glyph =: 3 : 0
    select. y
    case. '\sum' do. '\--';' > ';'/--'
    case. '\prod' do. '___';'| |';'| |'
    case. '\int' do. ' /';' |';'/ '
    end.
)
delimiter_glyph =: 4 : 0
    delimiter =. x
    height =. y
    if. delimiter-:,'.' do.
        0$a: return.
    end.
    character =. {:delimiter
    if. height=1 do.
        ,<,character return.
    end.
    if. (1=#delimiter)*.character e.'[]|' do.
        height$<,character return.
    end.
    left =. (delimiter-:,'(')+.delimiter-:'\{'
    first =. '\'
    last =. '/'
    if. left do.
        first =. '/'
        last =. '\'
    end.
    glyph =. (<,first),((height-2)$<,'|'),<,last
    if. ((<delimiter)e.'\{';'\}')*.height>:3 do.
        middle =. (height-1)intdiv 2
        character =. '>'
        if. left do.
            character =. '<'
        end.
        glyph =. (<,character)middle}glyph
    end.
    glyph
)
command_display =: 3 : '(CommandKeys i.<y){::CommandDisplays'
command_type =: 3 : '(CommandKeys i.<y){CommandTypes'
symbol_type =: 3 : 0
    character =. {.y
    if. character e.'+-*' do. 2
    elseif. character e.'=<>:' do. 3
    elseif. character e.'([' do. 4
    elseif. character e.')]!' do. 5
    elseif. character e.',;' do. 6
    else. 0 end.
)

trim_spaces =: 3 : 0
    text =. y
    while. #text do.
        if. ' '~:{:text do.
            break.
        end.
        text =. }:text
    end.
    text
)
walk_box =: 3 : 0
    'number xx yy level role' =. y
    box =. number{::BoxPool
    WalkRows =: WalkRows,<y
    for_child. 4{::box do.
        'child dx dy child_role' =. >child
        walk_box(<child),(<xx+dx),(<yy+dy),(<level+1),<child_role
    end.
)
walk_roots =: 3 : 0
    WalkRows =: 0$a:
    for_root. y do.
        'number xx yy' =. root
        walk_box(<number),(<xx),(<yy),(<0),<''
    end.
    WalkRows
)
draw_formula =: 3 : 0
    'roots width height' =. y
    grid =. (width*height)$' '
    for_row. walk_roots roots do.
        'number xx yy level role' =. >row
        box =. number{::BoxPool
        for_string. 5{::box do.
            'text dx dy' =. >string
            for_i. I.text~:' ' do.
                index =. (xx+dx+i)+width*(yy+dy)
                grid =. (i{text)index}grid
            end.
        end.
    end.
    lines =. 0$a:
    for_i. i.height do.
        lines =. lines,<trim_spaces width{.(i*width)}.grid
    end.
    lines
)
box_lines =: 3 : 0
    lines =. 0$a:
    kinds =. 0$a:
    depth =. 0
    for_row. walk_roots y do.
        'number xx yy level role' =. >row
        'width height baseline description children strings' =. number{::BoxPool
        line =. ((2*level)$' '),role,description,' x=',(integer xx),' y=',integer yy
        lines =. lines,<line,' w=',(integer width),' h=',(integer height),' b=',integer baseline
        depth =. depth>.level+1
        kinds =. kinds,<(description i.' '){.description
    end.
    (<lines),(<depth),<kinds
)

element_types =: 3 : 0
    node =. y{::NodePool
    'kind children value column' =. node
    select. kind
    case. 'symbol' do. type =. symbol_type value
    case. 'command' do. type =. command_type value
    case. 'delim' do. 4 5 return.
    case. 'script' do. element_types 0{children return.
    case. 'overset';'underset' do. element_types 1{children return.
    case. do. type =. 0
    end.
    type,type
)
converted_types =: 3 : 0
    types =. 0 2$0
    for_node. y do.
        types =. types,element_types node
    end.
    for_i. i.#y do.
        left =. (<i,0){types
        previous =. 0
        if. i>0 do.
            previous =. (<(i-1),1){types
        end.
        if. left=2 do.
            if. (i=0)+.previous e.2 1 3 4 6 do.
                types =. 0 i}types
            end.
        end.
        left =. (<i,0){types
        if. (left e.3 5 6)*.i>0 do.
            if. 2=(<(i-1),1){types do.
                types =. 0(i-1)}types
            end.
        end.
    end.
    if. #types do.
        if. 2=1{_1{types do.
            types =. 0((#types)-1)}types
        end.
    end.
    types
)
word_element =: 3 : 0
    'kind children value column' =. y{::NodePool
    if. kind-:'script' do.
        word_element 0{children
    elseif. kind-:'command' do.
        ((<}.value)e.GreekNames)+.value-:'\infty'
    else.
        0
    end.
)
alphanumeric_element =: 3 : 0
    'kind children value column' =. y{::NodePool
    if. ((<kind)e.'identifier';'number')+.word_element y do.
        1 return.
    end.
    if. kind-:'script' do.
        alphanumeric_element 0{children
    elseif. kind-:'accent' do.
        if. (<value)e.;:'overline hat vec dot tilde' do.
            alphanumeric_element 0{children
        else.
            0
        end.
    else.
        0
    end.
)
row_spacing =: 4 : 0
    style =. x
    nodes =. y
    types =. converted_types nodes
    table =. 0 1 _1 _2 0 0 0 1 1 _4 _2 0 0 0 _1 _1 _4 _4 _1 _4 _4
    table =. 7 7$table,_2 _2 _4 0 _2 0 0 0 0 _4 0 0 0 0 0 1 _1 _2 0 0 0 _3 _3 _4 _3 _3 _3 _3
    variable =. 0 0 0 0
    if. style-:'normal' do.
        variable =. 0,(parameter 'bin_space'),(parameter 'rel_space'),parameter 'punct_space'
    end.
    gaps =. i.0
    for_i. i.0>.(#nodes)-1 do.
        first =. i{nodes
        second =. (i+1){nodes
        if. (alphanumeric_element first)*.(alphanumeric_element second)*.(word_element first)+.word_element second do.
            gap =. 1
        else.
            right =. (<i,1){types
            left =. (<(i+1),0){types
            gap =. (<right,left){table
            if. gap<0 do.
                gap =. (-gap){variable
            end.
        end.
        gaps =. gaps,gap
    end.
    (<types),<gaps
)
assemble_row =: 3 : 0
    'children gaps description roles' =. y
    ascent =. 0
    descent =. 0
    width =. +/gaps
    for_child. children do.
        ascent =. ascent>.box_baseline child
        descent =. descent>.box_descent child
        width =. width+box_width child
    end.
    box =. new_box(<width),(<1+ascent+descent),(<ascent),<description
    position =. 0
    for_i. i.#children do.
        child =. i{children
        role =. i{::roles
        box add_child(<child),(<position),(<ascent-box_baseline child),<role
        position =. position+box_width child
        if. i<#gaps do.
            position =. position+i{gaps
        end.
    end.
    box
)

initialize_lexicon =: 3 : 0
    GreekNames =: ;:'alpha beta gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta iota kappa lambda mu nu xi pi rho sigma tau'
    GreekNames =: GreekNames,;:'upsilon phi chi psi omega Gamma Delta Theta Lambda Xi Pi Sigma Upsilon Phi Psi Omega'
    FunctionNames =: ;:'sin cos tan log ln exp det lim max min'
    LargeNames =: ;:'sum prod int'
    Accents =: ;:'overline hat vec dot tilde overbrace underbrace'
    Constructs =: ;:'frac binom overset underset sqrt left right'
    RawCommands =: ;:'text begin end tag label eqref'
    Environments =: ;:'matrix pmatrix bmatrix vmatrix cases'
    CommandNames =: GreekNames,FunctionNames,LargeNames
    CommandKeys =: 0$a:
    CommandDisplays =: 0$a:
    CommandTypes =: i.0
    for_name. CommandNames do.
        name =. >name
        CommandKeys =: CommandKeys,<('\',name)
        CommandDisplays =: CommandDisplays,<name
        type =. 0
        if. (<name)e.FunctionNames,LargeNames do.
            type =. 1
        end.
        CommandTypes =: CommandTypes,type
    end.
    names =. ;:'cdot times pm mp leq geq neq approx to infty ldots cdots quad'
    displays =. ('*';'x';'+-';'-+';'<=';'>=';'!=';'~=';'->';'oo';'...';'...'),<'  '
    types =. 2 2 2 2 3 3 3 3 3 0 0 0 0
    for_i. i.#names do.
        name =. i{::names
        CommandNames =: CommandNames,<name
        CommandKeys =: CommandKeys,<('\',name)
        CommandDisplays =: CommandDisplays,<,i{::displays
        CommandTypes =: CommandTypes,i{types
    end.
    CommandKeys =: CommandKeys,'\,';'\{';'\}'
    CommandDisplays =: CommandDisplays,(<,' '),(<,'{'),<,'}'
    CommandTypes =: CommandTypes,0 4 5
)
letter =: 3 : 'y e.''ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'''
digit =: 3 : 'y e.''0123456789'''
character_at =: 4 : 0
    if. (x>:0)*.x<#y do.
        x{y
    else.
        a.{~0
    end.
)
lex_formula =: 3 : 0
    line =. y
    tokens =. 0$a:
    position =. 0
    error =. 0$a:
    while. position<#line do.
        character =. position{line
        column =. position+1
        if. character=' ' do.
            position =. position+1
            continue.
        end.
        if. letter character do.
            end =. position+1
            while. letter end character_at line do.
                end =. end+1
            end.
            kind =. 'identifier'
            value =. (end-position){.position}.line
            position =. end
        elseif. digit character do.
            end =. position+1
            while. digit end character_at line do.
                end =. end+1
            end.
            if. ('.'=end character_at line)*.digit (end+1)character_at line do.
                end =. end+2
                while. digit end character_at line do.
                    end =. end+1
                end.
            end.
            kind =. 'number'
            value =. (end-position){.position}.line
            position =. end
        elseif. character e.'+-*/=<>:()[],;.!|''{}^_&' do.
            kind =. 'symbol'
            if. character e.'{}^_&' do.
                kind =. character
            end.
            value =. ,character
            position =. position+1
        elseif. character='\' do.
            position =. position+1
            escaped =. position character_at line
            if. escaped e.'\{},' do.
                kind =. 'command'
                if. escaped='\' do.
                    kind =. 'newline'
                end.
                value =. '\',escaped
                position =. position+1
            else.
                start =. position
                while. letter position character_at line do.
                    position =. position+1
                end.
                name =. (position-start){.start}.line
                if. 0=#name do.
                    error =. (<column),<'invalid command'
                    break.
                end.
                if. (<name)e.RawCommands do.
                    while. ' '=position character_at line do.
                        position =. position+1
                    end.
                    if. '{'~:position character_at line do.
                        error =. (<position+1),<'expected {'
                        break.
                    end.
                    rest =. (position+1)}.line
                    offset =. rest i.'}'
                    if. offset=#rest do.
                        error =. (<column),<'unterminated argument'
                        break.
                    end.
                    value =. offset{.rest
                    if. (<name)e.'begin';'end' do.
                        if. -.(<value)e.Environments do.
                            error =. (<column),<'unknown environment "',value,'"'
                            break.
                        end.
                    end.
                    kind =. name
                    position =. position+offset+2
                elseif. (<name)e.CommandNames do.
                    kind =. 'command'
                    value =. '\',name
                elseif. (<name)e.Accents do.
                    kind =. 'accent'
                    value =. name
                elseif. (<name)e.Constructs do.
                    kind =. name
                    value =. name
                else.
                    error =. (<column),<'unknown command \',name
                    break.
                end.
            end.
        else.
            error =. (<column),<'invalid character ',character
            break.
        end.
        tokens =. tokens,<( <kind),(<value),<column
    end.
    if. 0=#error do.
        tokens =. tokens,<( <'eof'),(<''),<1+#line
    end.
    (<tokens),<error
)

    if. index=#ReferenceNames do.
        '(??)'
    else.
        index{::ReferenceValues
    end.

center_box =: 4 : '(x-box_width y)intdiv 2'
draw_delimiter =: 4 : 0
    'delimiter position height' =. y
    glyph =. delimiter delimiter_glyph height
    for_i. i.#glyph do.
        x add_string(i{glyph),(<position),<i
    end.
    x

delimit_box =: 3 : 0
    'body left right' =. y
    left_width =. -.left-:,'.'
    right_width =. -.right-:,'.'
    width =. left_width+(box_width body)+right_width
    height =. box_height body
    description =. 'delim ',left,' ',right
    box =. new_box(<width),(<height),(<box_baseline body),<description
    box add_child(<body),(<left_width),(<0),<''
    box draw_delimiter(<left),(<0),<height
    box draw_delimiter(<right),(<left_width+box_width body),<height
    box
)
typeset_atom =: 4 : 0
    'kind children value column' =. y{::NodePool
    display =. value
    if. kind-:'text' do.
        description =. 'text "',value,'"'
    elseif. kind-:'reference' do.
        description =. 'eqref "',value,'"'
        display =. reference_display value
    else.
        description =. 'atom "',value,'"'
        if. kind-:'command' do.
            display =. command_display value
        end.
    end.
    large =. (kind-:'command')*.(x-:'normal')*.(<value)e.'\sum';'\prod';'\int'
    if. large do.
        glyph =. large_glyph value
        box =. new_box(<#0{::glyph),(<3),(<1),<description
        for_i. i.#glyph do.
            box add_string(i{glyph),(<0),<i
        end.
    else.
        box =. new_box(<#display),(<1),(<0),<description
        box add_string(<display),(<0),<0
    end.
    box
)
typeset_row =: 4 : 0
    nodes =. y
    'types gaps' =. x row_spacing nodes
    children =. i.0
    for_node. nodes do.
        children =. children,x typeset_node node
    end.
    roles =. (#children)$<''
    assemble_row(<children),(<gaps),(<'row'),<roles
)
typeset_script =: 4 : 0
    style =. x
    'kind children value column' =. y{::NodePool
    'base_node sub_node sup_node' =. children
    base =. style typeset_node base_node
    sub =. sup =. _1
    sub_width =. sub_height =. sup_width =. sup_height =. 0
    if. sub_node~:_1 do.
        sub =. 'script'typeset_node sub_node
        sub_width =. box_width sub
        sub_height =. box_height sub
    end.
    if. sup_node~:_1 do.
        sup =. 'script'typeset_node sup_node
        sup_width =. box_width sup
        sup_height =. box_height sup
    end.
    'base_kind base_children base_value base_column' =. base_node{::NodePool
    stacked =. 0
    if. style-:'normal' do.
        if. base_kind-:'command' do.
            stacked =. (<base_value)e.'\sum';'\prod';'\lim';'\max';'\min'
        elseif. base_kind-:'accent' do.
            stacked =. (<base_value)e.'overbrace';'underbrace'
        end.
    end.
    if. stacked do.
        width =. (box_width base)>.sub_width>.sup_width
        height =. sup_height+(box_height base)+sub_height
        baseline =. sup_height+box_baseline base
        box =. new_box(<width),(<height),(<baseline),<'limits'
        box add_child(<base),(<width center_box base),(<sup_height),<'base: '
        if. sub~:_1 do.
            box add_child(<sub),(<width center_box sub),(<sup_height+box_height base),<'sub: '
        end.
        if. sup~:_1 do.
            box add_child(<sup),(<width center_box sup),(<0),<'sup: '
        end.
    else.
        sup_bottom =. 0
        if. 0=box_baseline base do.
            sup_bottom =. _1
        end.
        sup_top =. (sup_bottom-sup_height)+1
        sub_top =. box_height base
        if. 0<box_descent base do.
            sub_top =. sub_top-1
        end.
        top =. 0
        if. sup~:_1 do.
            top =. 0<.sup_top
        end.
        bottom =. (box_height base)-1
        if. sub~:_1 do.
            bottom =. bottom>.(sub_top+sub_height)-1
        end.
        width =. (box_width base)+sub_width>.sup_width
        height =. (bottom-top)+1
        baseline =. (box_baseline base)-top
        box =. new_box(<width),(<height),(<baseline),<'scripts'
        box add_child(<base),(<0),(<-top),<'base: '
        if. sub~:_1 do.
            box add_child(<sub),(<box_width base),(<sub_top-top),<'sub: '
        end.
        if. sup~:_1 do.
            box add_child(<sup),(<box_width base),(<sup_top-top),<'sup: '
        end.
    end.
    box
)
typeset_fraction =: 4 : 0
    'kind children value column' =. y{::NodePool
    numerator =. x typeset_node 0{children
    denominator =. x typeset_node 1{children
    if. x-:'normal' do.
        width =. 2+(box_width numerator)>.box_width denominator
        baseline =. box_height numerator
        height =. baseline+1+box_height denominator
        box =. new_box(<width),(<height),(<baseline),<'frac'
        box add_child(<numerator),(<width center_box numerator),(<0),<'num: '
        box add_child(<denominator),(<width center_box denominator),(<baseline+1),<'den: '
        box add_string(<width$'-'),(<0),<baseline
    else.
        for_i. i.2 do.
            node =. (i{children){::NodePool
            if. (0{node)e.'row';'frac' do.
                if. i=0 do.
                    numerator =. delimit_box(<numerator),(<,'('),<,')'
                else.
                    denominator =. delimit_box(<denominator),(<,'('),<,')'
                end.
            end.
        end.
        slash =. new_box(<1),(<1),(<0),<'atom "/"'
        slash add_string(<,'/'),(<0),<0
        roles =. 'num: ';'';'den: '
        box =. assemble_row(<numerator,slash,denominator),(<0 0),(<'slash'),<roles
    end.
    box
)
typeset_binomial =: 4 : 0
    children =. 1{::y{::NodePool
    upper =. x typeset_node 0{children
    lower =. x typeset_node 1{children
    width =. (box_width upper)>.box_width lower
    baseline =. box_height upper
    height =. baseline+1+box_height lower
    box =. new_box(<width+2),(<height),(<baseline),<'binom'
    box add_child(<upper),(<1+width center_box upper),(<0),<'upper: '
    box add_child(<lower),(<1+width center_box lower),(<baseline+1),<'lower: '
    box draw_delimiter(<,'('),(<0),<height
    box draw_delimiter(<,')'),(<width+1),<height
    box
)
typeset_placed =: 4 : 0
    'kind children value column' =. y{::NodePool
    placed =. 'script'typeset_node 0{children
    base =. x typeset_node 1{children
    width =. (box_width placed)>.box_width base
    height =. (box_height placed)+box_height base
    baseline =. box_baseline base
    if. kind-:'overset' do.
        baseline =. baseline+box_height placed
    end.
    box =. new_box(<width),(<height),(<baseline),<kind
    if. kind-:'overset' do.
        box add_child(<placed),(<width center_box placed),(<0),<'over: '
        box add_child(<base),(<width center_box base),(<box_height placed),<'base: '
    else.
        box add_child(<base),(<width center_box base),(<0),<'base: '
        box add_child(<placed),(<width center_box placed),(<box_height base),<'under: '
    end.
    box
)
typeset_radical =: 4 : 0
    'kind children value column' =. y{::NodePool
    index =. _1
    extra =. top =. 0
    if. kind-:'root' do.
        index =. 'script'typeset_node 0{children
        body =. x typeset_node 1{children
        extra =. 0>.(box_width index)-1
        top =. 0>.(box_height index)-box_height body
    else.
        body =. x typeset_node 0{children
    end.
    k =. box_height body
    width =. extra+k+1+box_width body
    height =. k+1+top
    baseline =. (box_baseline body)+1+top
    box =. new_box(<width),(<height),(<baseline),<kind
    box add_string(<(box_width body)$'_'),(<extra+k+1),<top
    box add_string(<,'\'),(<extra),<k+top
    for_row. 1+i.k do.
        position =. extra+((k-row)+1)
        box add_string(<,'/'),(<position),<row+top
    end.
    if. index~:_1 do.
        box add_child(<index),(<0),(<top+k-box_height index),<'index: '
        box add_child(<body),(<extra+k+1),(<1+top),<'body: '
    else.
        box add_child(<body),(<extra+k+1),(<1),<''
    end.
    box
)
typeset_matrix =: 4 : 0
    'kind rows environment column' =. y{::NodePool
    row_count =. #rows
    column_count =. #0{::rows
    cells =. (row_count,column_count)$0
    for_i. i.row_count do.
        row =. i{::rows
        for_j. i.column_count do.
            child =. x typeset_node j{row
            cells =. child(<i,j)}cells
        end.
    end.
    widths =. column_count$0
    ascents =. row_count$0
    descents =. row_count$0
    for_i. i.row_count do.
        for_j. i.column_count do.
            child =. (<i,j){cells
            widths =. ((j{widths)>.box_width child)j}widths
            ascents =. ((i{ascents)>.box_baseline child)i}ascents
            descents =. ((i{descents)>.box_descent child)i}descents
        end.
    end.
    heights =. 1+ascents+descents
    col_gap =. parameter 'col_gap'
